newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Ingwe in Australia venture - report.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Ingwe in Australia venture - report.

text.p: South Africa's Ingwe Coal Corp Ltd is buying 96 percent of Coal Mines Australia in its first expansion venture abroad, national television reported on Tuesday.

Ingwe, owned by Gencor Ltd, had negotiated the purchase through an Australian investment house and hoped the deal would help it double exports over the next 10 years, the Business Tonight programme reported.
The 300 million rand ($66.2 million) purchase would be financed through bank loans and an equity settlement between Ingwe and Gencor, the report added.
Ingwe also planned to pump nearly 500 million rand in new equity into the mining venture, to pave the way for capital investment of nearly one billion rand.
The coal producer announced in August that its export sales had increased for the year to end June by about six percent to 24.5 million tonnes from 23.2 million tonnes in 1994/95.
Europe absorbed 51 percent of its exports with the Far East taking the next largest slice at 40 percent.
